  <script>

    let initialAdaptiveOn = false;
    let initialHandoffThresh = '';
    let initialHysteresis = '';
    let curveParamsValid = false;
    let curveParams = null;
    let minimumAllowedLux = null;

    // Calibration Polling State
    let calPollTimer = null;
    let isCalibrating = false;


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Tasker globals & Task execution                           */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function taskerGlobal(name) {
        try {
            const value = global(name);

            if (value === undefined
                    || value === null
                    || value === 'undef'
                    || value === name
                    || value === '%' + name) {
                return '';
            }

            return String(value);
        } catch (e) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    function taskerBoolean(name) {
        const val = taskerGlobal(name).trim().toLowerCase();
        return val === 'true' || val === 'on';
    }

    function setTaskerGlobal(name, value) {
        const cleanName = (name && name.indexOf('%') === 0)
            ? name.substring(1)
            : name;

        try {
            setGlobal(cleanName, String(value));
        } catch (e) {
        }
    }

    function performTaskSafe(taskName, priority, p1, p2) {
        try {
            if (typeof performTask === 'function') {
                performTask(taskName, priority, p1, p2);
            } else {
                console.warn('performTask is not available in this environment:', taskName);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Error invoking performTask:', e);
        }
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Display Calibration State & Handlers                      */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function getCalibrationState() {
        const cal = taskerGlobal('AAB_BrightCal');
        const needsCal = taskerGlobal('AAB_NeedsCal').toLowerCase();

        if (cal === 'running') {
            return 'running';
        }
        if (cal === 'error') {
            return 'error';
        }
        if (needsCal === 'true') {
            return 'needed';
        }
        // Valid calibration string verification (at least contains step markers)
        if (cal && cal.indexOf(':') !== -1 && cal.indexOf(',') !== -1) {
            return 'calibrated';
        }
        return 'uncalibrated';
    }

    function updateCalibrationUI() {
        const badge = document.getElementById('cal-status-badge');
        const note = document.getElementById('cal-note');
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-calibrate');
        const errBanner = document.getElementById('cal-error-banner');

        if (!badge || !note || !btn) return;

        const state = getCalibrationState();

        badge.className = 'badge';
        errBanner.style.display = 'none';

        switch (state) {
            case 'running':
                badge.classList.add('badge-yellow');
                badge.textContent = 'Calibrating...';
                note.textContent = 'Screen brightness steps are actively being tested. Please wait...';
                btn.textContent = 'Calibrating...';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-dark btn-disabled';
                break;

            case 'calibrated':
                badge.classList.add('badge-green');
                badge.textContent = 'Calibrated';
                note.textContent = 'Hardware brightness curve is verified. Display supports HBM reading above 255.';
                btn.textContent = 'Recalibrate Display';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-dark';
                break;

            case 'error':
                badge.classList.add('badge-red');
                badge.textContent = 'Failed';
                note.textContent = 'Last calibration failed. Elevated privileges or permissions were not detected.';
                errBanner.style.display = 'block';
                btn.textContent = 'Retry Calibration';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-teal';
                break;

            case 'needed':
                badge.classList.add('badge-yellow');
                badge.textContent = 'Update Needed';
                note.textContent = 'Device fingerprint changed or calibration was invalidated. Calibration recommended.';
                btn.textContent = 'Calibrate Display';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-teal';
                break;

            case 'uncalibrated':
            default:
                badge.classList.add('badge-yellow');
                badge.textContent = 'Not Calibrated';
                note.textContent = 'Display range is uncalibrated. Readings will be capped at standard 255.';
                btn.textContent = 'Calibrate Display';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-teal';
                break;
        }
    }

    function handleCalibrationClick() {
        if (isCalibrating) return;

        const state = getCalibrationState();

        if (state === 'calibrated') {
            const proceed = confirm(
                "Display is already calibrated.\n\nRecalibrating will cycle screen brightness levels for several seconds. Do you want to proceed?"
            );
            if (!proceed) return;
        }

        startCalibration();
    }

    function startCalibration() {
        isCalibrating = true;
        setTaskerGlobal('AAB_BrightCal', 'running');
        updateCalibrationUI();

        showFlash('Starting display calibration. Do not touch the screen...', 3500);

        performTaskSafe('_CalibrateDisplayRange', 10);

        let attempts = 0;
        const maxAttempts = 50; // 50 * 500ms = 25 seconds max

        if (calPollTimer) clearInterval(calPollTimer);

        calPollTimer = setInterval(function() {
            attempts++;
            const currentCal = taskerGlobal('AAB_BrightCal');

            if (currentCal !== 'running') {
                clearInterval(calPollTimer);
                isCalibrating = false;
                updateCalibrationUI();

                if (currentCal === 'error') {
                    showFlash('⚠️ Calibration failed. Check Tasker DUMP permission.', 4000);
                } else if (currentCal.indexOf(':') !== -1) {
                    showFlash('✓ Display successfully calibrated.', 3500);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                clearInterval(calPollTimer);
                isCalibrating = false;
                setTaskerGlobal('AAB_BrightCal', 'error');
                updateCalibrationUI();
                showFlash('⚠️ Calibration timed out.', 4000);
            }
        }, 500);
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Parameter Ingestion (No Fictitious Fallbacks)             */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function loadCurveParameters() {
        const parse = (name) => {
            const raw = taskerGlobal(name);
            if (!raw) return null;
            const n = parseFloat(raw);
            return (!isNaN(n) && isFinite(n)) ? n : null;
        };

        const z1End = parse('AAB_Zone1End');
        const z2End = parse('AAB_Zone2End');
        const f1A   = parse('AAB_Form1A');
        const f2A   = parse('AAB_Form2A');
        const f2B   = parse('AAB_Form2B');
        const f2C   = parse('AAB_Form2C');
        const f3A   = parse('AAB_Form3A');
        const maxB  = parse('AAB_MaxBright');

        if (z1End === null || z2End === null ||
            f1A === null   || f2A === null   || f2B === null || f2C === null ||
            f3A === null   || maxB === null) {
            return { valid: false };
        }

        return {
            valid: true,
            z1End, z2End,
            f1A, f2A, f2B, f2C, f3A,
            maxB
        };
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Base Curve Evaluation                                     */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function calculateBaseBrightness(lux, p) {
        if (lux < p.z1End) {
            return p.f1A * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, lux));
        } else if (lux < p.z2End) {
            const t1 = Math.pow(Math.max(0, lux - p.f2C), 0.33);
            const t2 = Math.pow(Math.max(0, p.z1End - p.f2C), 0.33);
            return p.f2A + p.f2B * (t1 - t2);
        } else {
            if (lux <= 0) return 0;
            return p.maxB - (p.f3A / lux) * p.maxB;
        }
    }

    function calculateMinimumAllowedLux(p) {
        const targetBright = 0.9 * p.maxB;

        const analyticalZone3Lux = 10 * p.f3A;

        if (analyticalZone3Lux >= p.z2End) {
            return analyticalZone3Lux;
        }

        let low = 0;
        let high = Math.max(p.z2End, 10000);
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (calculateBaseBrightness(mid, p) >= targetBright) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid;
            }
        }
        return high;
    }

    function formatLuxDisplay(val, p) {
        const targetBright = 0.9 * p.maxB;
        const intVal = Math.round(val);

        if (Math.abs(val - intVal) < 0.005 &&
            calculateBaseBrightness(intVal, p) >= targetBright - 1e-5) {
            return String(intVal);
        }

        let decVal = Math.round(val * 100) / 100;
        if (calculateBaseBrightness(decVal, p) < targetBright - 1e-5) {
            decVal = Math.ceil(val * 100) / 100;
        }
        return String(decVal);
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* UI Helpers                                                */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function toggleInfo(id) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.display = el.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function showFlash(message, duration) {
        const el = document.getElementById('flash-message');
        if (!el) return;

        el.textContent = message;
        el.style.visibility = 'visible';
        el.style.opacity = '1';

        setTimeout(() => {
            el.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => {
                el.style.visibility = 'hidden';
            }, 300);
        }, duration || 2500);
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Dirty State Tracking                                      */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function checkDirty() {
        const toggle = document.getElementById('adaptive-toggle');
        const input = document.getElementById('handoff-thresh-input');
        const histSlider = document.getElementById('hysteresis-slider');
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-apply');
        const warning = document.getElementById('thresh-warning');

        if (!toggle || !input || !btn) return;

        if (warning) {
            warning.style.display = 'none';
        }

        const currentAdaptiveOn = toggle.checked;
        const currentHandoffThresh = input.value.trim();
        const currentHysteresis = histSlider ? (parseInt(histSlider.value) / 100).toString() : initialHysteresis;

        const isDirty = (currentAdaptiveOn !== initialAdaptiveOn)
                     || (currentHandoffThresh !== initialHandoffThresh.trim())
                     || (currentHysteresis !== initialHysteresis);

        if (isDirty) {
            btn.textContent = 'Apply';
            btn.classList.remove('btn-disabled');
        } else {
            btn.textContent = 'Applied';
            btn.classList.add('btn-disabled');
        }
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Apply Changes with Gated Validation                       */
    /* ========================================================= */

    function applyChanges() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-apply');
        const toggle = document.getElementById('adaptive-toggle');
        const input = document.getElementById('handoff-thresh-input');
        const histSlider = document.getElementById('hysteresis-slider');
        const warning = document.getElementById('thresh-warning');
        const suggestedDisplay = document.getElementById('suggested-thresh-val');

        if (!btn || btn.classList.contains('btn-disabled')) return;

        const willBeEnabled = toggle.checked;

        if (willBeEnabled) {
            if (!curveParamsValid) {
                showFlash('Cannot enable: Tasker curve parameters uninitialized.', 3500);
                return;
            }

            const targetBright = 0.9 * curveParams.maxB;
            const rawInput = input.value.trim();
            const currentLux = parseFloat(rawInput);

            const currentBright = (isNaN(currentLux) || currentLux < 0)
                ? -1
                : calculateBaseBrightness(currentLux, curveParams);

            if (currentBright < (targetBright - 1e-5)) {
                const suggestedLuxStr = formatLuxDisplay(minimumAllowedLux, curveParams);

                input.value = suggestedLuxStr;

                if (warning && suggestedDisplay) {
                    suggestedDisplay.textContent = suggestedLuxStr;
                    warning.style.display = 'block';
                }

                btn.textContent = 'Apply';
                btn.classList.remove('btn-disabled');

                showFlash('Chosen lux threshold is too low. Suggested level set to ' + suggestedLuxStr + ' lux. Tap Apply again to save.', 4000);
                return;
            }
        }

        const newAdaptiveVal = willBeEnabled ? 'true' : 'false';
        const newThreshVal = input.value.trim();
        const newHysteresisVal = histSlider ? (parseInt(histSlider.value) / 100).toString() : '0.8';

        setTaskerGlobal('AAB_AdaptiveOn', newAdaptiveVal);
        setTaskerGlobal('AAB_AdaptiveHandoffThresh', newThreshVal);
        setTaskerGlobal('AAB_HandoffHysteresis', newHysteresisVal);

        initialAdaptiveOn = willBeEnabled;
        initialHandoffThresh = newThreshVal;
        initialHysteresis = newHysteresisVal;

        if (warning) {
            warning.style.display = 'none';
        }

        btn.textContent = 'Applied';
        btn.classList.add('btn-disabled');

        showFlash('Adaptive settings applied.');
    }


    /* ========================================================= */
    /* Initialisation                                            */
    /* ========================================================= */

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const toggle = document.getElementById('adaptive-toggle');
        const input = document.getElementById('handoff-thresh-input');
        const histSlider = document.getElementById('hysteresis-slider');
        const histDisplay = document.getElementById('hysteresis-val-display');
        const missingBanner = document.getElementById('curve-missing-banner');
        const curveNote = document.getElementById('curve-minimum-note');

        // Check Display Calibration Status
        updateCalibrationUI();

        // Retrieve settings
        initialAdaptiveOn = taskerBoolean('AAB_AdaptiveOn');
        initialHandoffThresh = taskerGlobal('AAB_AdaptiveHandoffThresh');
        
        const rawHysteresis = taskerGlobal('AAB_HandoffHysteresis');
        let histVal = 80;
        if (rawHysteresis !== '') {
            const parsedHist = parseFloat(rawHysteresis);
            if (!isNaN(parsedHist)) {
                histVal = Math.round(parsedHist * 100);
                if (histVal < 50) histVal = 50;
                if (histVal > 100) histVal = 100;
            }
        }
        initialHysteresis = (histVal / 100).toString();

        // Ingest curve parameters
        curveParams = loadCurveParameters();
        curveParamsValid = curveParams.valid;

        if (missingBanner) {
            missingBanner.style.display = curveParamsValid ? 'none' : 'block';
        }

        if (curveParamsValid) {
            minimumAllowedLux = calculateMinimumAllowedLux(curveParams);
            const minFormatted = formatLuxDisplay(minimumAllowedLux, curveParams);
            if (curveNote) {
                curveNote.textContent = 'Base curve minimum handoff threshold: ≥ ' + minFormatted + ' lux.';
            }
        } else {
            if (curveNote) {
                curveNote.textContent = 'Curve parameters unavailable. Threshold validation offline.';
            }
        }

        if (toggle) {
            toggle.checked = initialAdaptiveOn;
            toggle.addEventListener('change', checkDirty);
        }

        if (input) {
            input.value = initialHandoffThresh;
            input.addEventListener('input', checkDirty);
        }

        if (histSlider) {
            histSlider.value = histVal;
            if (histDisplay) {
                histDisplay.textContent = histVal + '%';
            }
            histSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
                if (histDisplay) {
                    histDisplay.textContent = this.value + '%';
                }
                checkDirty();
            });
        }
    });

  </script>
</body>
